newsitem.title: USA: American Rivers Oil to merge, spinoff unit.
newsitem.headline: American Rivers Oil to merge, spinoff unit.

text.p: American Rivers Oil Co said Tuesday that it has signed a letter of intent to merge with Opon Development Co.
Opon's only asset is a 4.55 percent working interest in the Opon oil and gas field in Colombia, South America, American Rivers said.
American Rivers closed trading Monday at 1-7/16 a share.
The company also said it plans to spin off its Bishop Capital Corp subsidiary to common stock holders of record date November 18. The unit has a net worth of about $2 million, the company said.
Opon shareholders would own 90 to 95 percent of American Rivers after the merger, and Opon management would operate the company, American Rivers said.
American Rivers said its oil and gas operations would continue after the merger, which is expected to be completed in the first quarter 1997.
